Messages.Author: Geb
Messages.Body:
hello all

i have a question about the use of telephatic tracking and s:ce that
do damage after combat (such as catatonic fear). Is the damage resolve
at the end of the other round? is never resolved? if the minion using
the s:ce goes to torpor in the second round is resolved?

btw, if minion against is played the s:ce goes to torpor is resolved
too the damage?

bye
Geb

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Telepathic Tracking (superior) causes the "after combat" damage effect
to be lost. [LSJ 02-FEB-2001]
